chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abā 'Abdillāh عليه السلام about the recitation on Friday: if I pray alone four rak'ahs, should I recite aloud? He said, "Yes."

key_terms.وَحْدِي: alone, individually and not in congregation
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day on which this ruling applies

ai.seo_question: Should a person praying alone on Friday recite aloud in the four-rak'ah prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about recitation in prayer on Friday for one who prays alone. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام affirms that such a person may recite aloud when performing four rak'ahs individually on Friday.
